record.title: Thread messages are pasted verbatim into QwenPaw by the relay with no sanitisation — prompt injection is latent until the relay is installed
record.description: Code trace verified as written, but the finding fails the 7-Question Gate and is not a standalone vulnerability: the sink does not exist today (relay is a repo file, explicitly not installed), verbatim delivery of discussion context to the agent is the relay's documented intended behaviour, no instruction execution was demonstrated, and setting GROUPCHAT_TOKEN closes the only unauthenticated planting path, making this fully redundant with groupchat-open-thread.

trace.what: POST /thread/message stores text = cleanText(body.text); cleanText (line 98) is only trim().slice(0,4000) — no sanitisation, verified.
build_digest (lines 118-127) appends last 12 messages verbatim as '[role:author] text' into the digest.

deliver_to_agent (lines 132-140) passes digest as --text to 'docker exec qwenpaw qwenpaw agents chat' — but this sink is LATENT ONLY: README line 12 and relay.py line 27 state the relay is a repo file, NOT installed, install is a coordinator decision.

evidence.output: 118:def build_digest(thread, agent); 126:for m in thread["messages"][-12:]: lines.append(f"[{m['role']}:{m['author']}] {m['text']}"); 132:def deliver_to_agent; 134:digest = build_digest(thread, agent); 136-140: docker exec qwenpaw qwenpaw agents chat ... --text digest

evidence.command: grep -n 'cleanText|const text|role === .agent.|author !== thread.next_agent' worker/src/index.js; grep -n 'not installed|coordinator decision' README.md relay.py
evidence.output: index.js:98 cleanText trim().slice(0,4000); 207:text=cleanText(body.text); 217-221: role=agent requires PARTICIPANTS.includes(author) and author===next_agent, else 400/409; README:12 relay (repo file, not installed); relay.py:27 Install (coordinator decision — NOT installed by the build)

record.conditions: Would only become assessable if the relay were installed AND GROUPCHAT_TOKEN were left unset AND an embedded instruction were demonstrated to be executed by the live agent despite its system prompt and the [role:author] labelling — i.e. exactly the groupchat-open-thread chain, not a separate finding.
record.remediation: Setting GROUPCHAT_TOKEN first is correct and sufficient to close the unauthenticated planting path; the proposed delimiters / 'untrusted data' labelling in build_digest is sound optional hardening for a future install, not a fix for a live vulnerability. No relay install or live-agent delivery was performed.
record.reason: Rejected under the 7-Question Gate: Q1 fails — no copy-pasteable request reaches the agent today because the relay sink is not installed; Q5 fails — the agent reading the discussion verbatim is the documented intended behaviour (relay header/README: agent is meant to reply as its part of the group discussion), so 'agent reads discussion' is not 'attacker instruction injection'; Q6 fails — no execution demonstrated, only 'technically possible', and the digest's [role:author] labelling plus the agent system prompt are untested mitigations; per the skill's conditionally-valid table, prompt injection alone requires a demonstrated chain (e.g. reading other users' data), which is absent. The hunter's 'no provenance for role=agent' claim is also overstated: index.js:217-221 enforces agent posts to a participant who is next_agent, so an attacker can only plant role=user text. Once GROUPCHAT_TOKEN is set, only the owner — who already has direct QwenPaw access — can supply thread text, so no new attacker capability remains; this finding is redundant with groupchat-open-thread.
